name: Kageyama Mirai
source: Mirai is a charismatic student attending a prestigious university in the city. He works as a model and the president of a venture company, and there is even a rumor that he is part of an underground community... Shrouded in mystery, Mirai is frequently sighted in international locales like America, Hong Kong, Shanghai, and Dubai.
